summary: The Windows local screen-share preview now uses the Android sender-stat sampling path and displays encoded resolution, FPS, bitrate and RTT. Remote shares retain receiver-side counters. Local sender data is shown in the client; Android-only telemetry submission retains its existing platform contract.
